jobs.description:
Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
  • Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
  • Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
  • Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
  • Clinical Days at Goal
  • 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
  • Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
  • Schedule-entry timeliness
  • Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
  • Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
  • Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
  • Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

  • Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
  • Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
  • Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

You'll also play a key role in how we build and scale AI-native ways of working within G&A, identifying where intelligent tooling can sharpen decision-making, accelerate execution, and give the CFO's office a genuine edge. Your profile:

  • You bring deep project management experience and a proven track record of leading complex initiatives from inception to completion — you know how to create structure where there is none and keep things moving even when the path isn't clear.

  • You have a builder's mindset — you don't just identify what needs to change, you roll up your sleeves and make it happen. Whether that's designing a new process, standing up an AI workflow, or structuring a framework from scratch, you know when to think and when to build.

  • You're a natural problem solver with a bias for action: you find scalable solutions, work comfortably with abstract ideas across multiple areas, and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.

  • You've handled sensitive and confidential financial material in a public company setting, and you bring the discretion and judgment that comes with it.

  • You communicate with clarity and confidence — whether in writing or in person — and you're equally comfortable presenting to the C-Suite and Board as you are collaborating with peers across the organization.

  • You're excited about AI and have hands-on experience applying AI tools or building AI-powered workflows in a professional context — you understand where the technology genuinely helps and where it falls short.

  • You're a calm, organized, and low-ego operator who works well with a wide range of people, inspires collaborative solutions, and knows when to lead and when to listen.

  • You're genuinely excited by new challenges and have a track record of growing your scope over time by consistently delivering and earning trust

Why Taxfix?

jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI

In person in Grafenwöhr, Germany

 

Why This Role Exists

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.

 

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

  • Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

  • Lead or support exercises.

  • Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

  • Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

  • When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

  • Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

  • Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

  • Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

  • Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

  • Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

  • Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

  • Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

  • Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

  • You hold a current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

  • Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

  • You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

  • You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

 

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

  • Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

  • Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (Forward-leaning/ bias for action)

  • Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (Adaptability/ Humility)


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

Als Cloud Monitoring Manager (m/w/d) Wärmepumpe bist du die erste technische Instanz, wenn Anlagen nicht so funktionieren wie sie sollen. Die Störungsanalyse und Fehlerbehebung erfolgen dabei vollständig remote, über unsere eigenen sowie herstellereigene Cloud- und Monitoring-Plattformen, auf denen Anlagendaten in Echtzeit einlaufen (z. B. die Panasonic Aquarea Smart Cloud).

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Reaktiver Support: Bearbeitung eingehender App-Monitoring-Tickets, Kundenanfragen und Störungsmeldungen – schnell, kompetent und lösungsorientiert.

  • Technischer Support & Anlagensteuerung: Analyse von Kundenproblemen aus der Ferne, Vornahme von Anlageneinstellungen sowie Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Nachbereitung von Service-Einsätzen.

  • Problemlösung & Fehleranalyse: Entwicklung skalierbarer Lösungsansätze für wiederkehrende Störungsbilder – z. B. bei Warmwasser, Lautstärkebeschwerden oder mangelhafter Heizleistung.

  • Wissensmanagement: Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Bedienungsanleitungen, FAQs sowie internen Wissensdatenbanken – damit technisches Know-how im Team zugänglich bleibt.

  • Dokumentation & Recherche: Recherche von Fachfragen, Normen und Wärmepumpenregelungen mit strukturierter Dokumentation für den internen Gebrauch.

  • Kapazitätsmanagement: Aktive Unterstützung beim Abfedern saisonaler Lastspitzen – gleichbleibend hohe Lösungsqualität auch in Hochphasen.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Maschinenbau, Energietechnik, Gebäudetechnik, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Fach.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Heizungsanlagen und Wärmepumpen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englisch von Vorteil.

  • Nice to have: Erfahrung im Monitoring von Photovoltaik-, Wärmepumpe- oder Elektroauto-Daten.

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

  • Methodical Problem Solver: Du gehst Störungen systematisch auf den Grund, findest die Ursache – nicht nur das Symptom – und entwickelst Lösungen, die das Problem nachhaltig beheben. Deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hilft dir, neue Fehlerbilder zügig einzuordnen.

  • Proactive Documenter: Du erkennst, wann Wissen festgehalten werden muss, und hältst Prozesse, Lösungen und Standards kontinuierlich aktuell – klar formuliert, strukturiert und für andere direkt nutzbar.

  • Technical Curiosity: Du willst verstehen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, nicht nur wie man es behebt. Du gehst tiefer als nötig, liest dich ein und baust so ein Fachwissen auf, das dem gesamten Team zugutekommt.

  • Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

  • Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare
Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties, thereby creating value for both providers and patients. We work with leading healthcare experts and stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital rating are published in collaboration with leading media partners worldwide, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets. Learn more about Statista Healthcare: healthcare.statista.com

As part of our business development initiatives, we are strengthening our strategic partnerships and paving the way for strategic and successful growth in our healthcare business unit.

To support this growth, we are looking for a motivated Working Student Healthcare Business Development and Operations (m/f/d) to join our team as soon as possible.

Your Role

  • Healthcare CRM set up and maintenance: Keep CRM data up to date to track healthcare business opportunities

  • Knowledge space ownership: Structure and maintain our internal knowledge space using AI to leverage team collaboration

  • Healthcare leadership team admin: Organize conference bookings and vendor communication, handle SAP invoicing processes, and coordinate meetings for our Vice President and in Business Development projects

Your skills

  • Enrollment: You must be enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Hamburg for at least one more year

  • Interest and skills in using AI tools to structure knowledge, automate routine admin tasks, and increase efficiency

  • Strong organizational skills for managing bookings, invoices, and data with accuracy

  • Confident with or eager to learn SAP; comfortable navigating multiple systems in parallel

  • Language: Excellent written and spoken English skills, German is a plus

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

Please note that the tasks listed for this position are subject to change, as we operate in a very dynamic environment at Statista. If you share our enthusiasm for transforming the healthcare industry with data, we’d be delighted to hear from you!

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

jobs.title: New Business Manager
jobs.description:

Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join our European Legal team. This individual will be covering a broad and complex portfolio of regulatory and commercial topics, including marketplace seller matters, product compliance, customs law, payment regulation, and warehouse and logistics agreements. The role requires someone who combines deep legal expertise with strong business acumen, the ability to lead and develop a team, and the drive to build scalable legal frameworks in a fast-paced, cross-border environment.

  • Manage payment regulation compliance and lead contract negotiations with Payment Service Provider (PSP) partners.
  • Draft and manage logistics agreements, including warehouse, supplier, and last-mile carrier contracts and liability.

  • Manage relationships with external counsel and regulatory bodies.

  • Expert ability to negotiate complex, multi-party commercial contracts within international corporate structures.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 


What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

jobs.title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
jobs.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail


How You’ll Grow

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you.


What You Get

  • Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product
  • Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs
  • A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers
  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

  • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit.


Your profile

  • Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.


Why us?

  • Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland.

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way.

About Bike Club

Bike Club is the easiest way to keep kids on the right sized bike. Through our subscription model, we remove the hassle of buying, outgrowing and reselling children's bikes, so families always have the right bike, right when they need it. We are a purpose led, fast-growing business built on ease, care, progress and joy - with a relentless focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling.

Purpose of the Role

The Head of Operations owns the system that runs Rainham: the plan, the standard, the data and the forward view. This is a new role, created as Rainham becomes both a refurb centre and a national distribution site from January 2027.

This is a planning, analytical and continuous improvement role first as well as a people management role. The Head of Operations will build the system the warehouse team, mechanic team and distribution team deliver against and will be ultimately accountable for whether the site performs both efficiently and effectively.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

1. Demand, capacity and forward planning

  • Own capacity planning end to end: built stock cover, inbound space, returns and disposal flow, physical site capacity as the site takes on distribution volume.
  • Build and stress test the peak plan well ahead of demand, including Christmas peak, modelling labour, space and carrier capacity against it.
  • Run rigorous what-if scenario planning: model the impact of demand shifts, supply delays, absence and carrier disruption before they happen, not after.
  • Set build volume targets from demand and the labour model that delivers them, and own whether the number lands.

2. Data, systems and reporting

  • Own data integrity across the site: build, dispatch and inventory reporting must reconcile, and any variance is investigated, not repeated.
  • Fluent in Salesforce (ideal) and confident evaluating or evolving a WMS suited to the site's needs as it scales.
  • Own the design of scanning, location and inventory status processes/workflow that the Distribution Manager and Mechanic Team execute.
  • Build the reporting the business needs to trust: no repeat of build numbers running on an unvalidated figure

3. Inventory and stock governance

  • Own inventory accuracy, cycle count governance and disposal authorisation across the site
  • Set the reorder points and supplier process for packaging and consumables for the Distribution Manager to own and execute upon.
  • Reconcile stock movements regularly and investigate variance as standard daily practice - not as a reaction to a discovered problem.

4. Performance framework and quality

  • Design and own the performance framework: what good output looks like, how it is measured, and when it is escalated
  • Design the QC gates built into both the build and despatch process, so defects are caught by design and automation where applicable.
  • Set the standard for order completeness and despatch accuracy, and firmly hold the site to it.
  • Own the formal performance management framework, including how underperformance is identified, documented and addressed

5. Continuous improvement

  • Continuous improvement is a default operating habit of this role, not a project or an initiative
  • Bring a lean methodology to daily operations: identify waste, standardise process, remove friction, on an ongoing basis
  • Apply automation and AI where it genuinely improves accuracy or throughput 6. Despatch performance
  • Single point of accountability for on-time-in-full dispatch performance to all members. The Distribution Manager owns the execution but you are accountable.

7. Team leadership

  • Lead all Site functions; the Distribution Manager, the warehouse (Goods In/Bike Wash teams), and the Mechanic Teams.
  • Set clear objectives for each line, reviewed monthly, and hold each accountable for delivery against the plan
  • Build the structure needed under each line as the site scales, including supervisory layers where a team requires one. (i.e. Mechanic supervisor)
  • Maintain and continuously improve the company’s safety management systems in alignment with OHSAS

Performance Metrics

  • OTIF despatch performance, site wide
  • Inventory accuracy and cycle count variance
  • 100% fulfilment guarantee. (if a SKU is available and not on site it must be built within 24hrs)
  • Build output against target, and build quality against standard
  • Packaging and consumables stock cover, zero stockouts.
  • Data reconciliation accuracy, build to despatch to inventory
  • Peak plan delivery against forecast
  • Continuous improvement initiatives delivered and their measured impact

Requirements

Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Proven experience running a modern, multi-function warehouse or distribution site at scale
  • Background in D2C logistics and industrial manufacturing
  • Strong quantitative and analytical ability: comfortable building and interrogating models, not just reading dashboards
  • Genuine continuous improvement or lean background, applied as a default way of working to black belt standard.
  • AI native - Fluency and experience is a must
  • Commercially and technically fluent, including confidence with Salesforce, WMS systems and warehouse automation
  • Track record of building control environments: inventory accuracy, reporting integrity, performance frameworks, where none existed before
  • Experience managing carrier relationships
  • Strong people leadership through both line managers and direct floor management Desirable
  • Experience in a circular economy or refurbishment-led operating model
  • Experience building a WMS from scratch or its continuous evolution
  • Peak season planning experience in a high SKU count, seasonal demand environment

Our Values

We look for people who live our values every day:

Ease: we make things simple for our members and for each other.

Care: we look after our customers, our colleagues and our bikes.

Progress: we keep improving, learning and raising the bar.

Joy: we help kids fall in love with cycling, and enjoy the work we do.

Benefits

🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays

💷Pension salary sacrifice

🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave

🚴Employee Discount on our bikes and Cycle to Work Scheme

Why Bike Club?

You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow.

This is a rare opportunity to build the operating system for our national refurbishment and distribution site from the ground up, shaping how Bike Club gets the right bike to every family, right when they need it.

Wir befinden uns in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Menschen geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen.

Wenn Du Teil eines engagierten Teams sein möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels gestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Bei bonial sorgt unser People Operations Team dafür, dass sich Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während der gesamten Employee Journey auf reibungslose und mitarbeiterorientierte Prozesse verlassen können. Dabei verbinden wir operatives Anpacken mit dem Anspruch, unsere Zusammenarbeit und unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aktuell wechseln wir von Personio zu SAP HCM – ein wichtiger Schritt für unser Team und für die Art, wie wir unsere People-Prozesse gestalten. Hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Als unser:e (Mid–Senior) People Operations Manager:in übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich, begleitest die Einführung von SAP HCM und hilfst uns, den Übergang für das gesamte Team so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unseren People Business Partner:innen, Payroll sowie weiteren internen und externen Stakeholder:innen zusammen.

Die Position ist ab dem Startdatum zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich und bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte.

  • Du steuerst unsere zentralen administrativen Prozesse entlang der Employee Journey – von Verträgen und Bescheinigungen über das Abwesenheitsmanagement bis hin zu Visa-Prozessen gemeinsam mit unserer externen Agentur.

  • Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung unserer monatlichen Gehaltsabrechnung und arbeitest eng mit unserem externen Payroll-Dienstleister zusammen, damit die Abrechnung korrekt und pünktlich erfolgt.

  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung und setzt deine Ideen in pragmatische und nachhaltige Lösungen um.

  • Du behältst Änderungen im Arbeitsrecht und Best Practices im People-Operations-Bereich im Blick und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen für bonial ab.

  • Als Teil des Teams unterstützt Du regelmäßig unsere Bürotage und Vor-Ort-Termine, zum Beispiel Onboardings und Unterschriftentermine.



Dein Profil:

  • Du bringst umfangreiche Berufserfahrung in People Operations, HR-Administration oder einer vergleichbaren generalistischen HR-Rolle mit.

  • Du verstehst, was gute Datenqualität, verlässliche Prozesse und ein reibungsloses Tagesgeschäft brauchen – und wie diese Themen zusammenspielen.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Struktur und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch in deine Themen.

  • Du bist hands-on, lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Veränderungen gemeinsam mit dem Team zu gestalten.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholder:innen und bleibst auch bei komplexen Themen ruhig und konstruktiv.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2), sodass Du auch in unserem internationalen Umfeld sicher zusammenarbeiten kannst.

  • Du verfügst über fundierte und aktuelle Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung in der vorbereitenden Gehaltsabrechnung.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits eine HR-Systemeinführung, eine Prozessmigration oder ein vergleichbares Transformationsprojekt begleitet. Erfahrung mit SAP HCM ist ein großes Plus.

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.
Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).*

Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können.

Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.*

Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen.

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“

Als Teil der Axel Springer Gruppe orientieren wir uns zusätzlich an den Axel Springer Essentials. 

Hört sich das gut an für Dich? Wir freuen uns von Dir zu hören!

Besuche uns gerne auch auf unserer bonial_people Instagram Seite oder erfahre mehr über unsere bonial-Kultur unter bonial Medium.

jobs.title: Sales Support & Account Operations Specialist (Arabic, French and English)
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a dedicated Cloudflare service and delivery partner operating across the Middle East, North Africa and Europe.

We specialise in Cloudflare licensing, support plans, professional services and managed offerings, working closely with clients, distributors and Cloudflare teams to support effective delivery and long-term customer success.

As we continue to expand our Cloudflare business across the MENAT region, we are looking for a Sales Support & Account Operations Specialist to strengthen our commercial operations and support the execution of our growing sales pipeline.

The Role

This is a hands-on commercial operations role supporting the day-to-day execution of the sales cycle.

Working closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, partners and distributors, you will help ensure that opportunities move efficiently from initial engagement through quoting, coordination, follow-up and renewal.

You will be responsible for keeping commercial activity organised and moving forward — from preparing quotes and maintaining CRM data to tracking renewals, coordinating partners and supporting client interactions.

The role would suit someone who is highly organised, responsive and comfortable working across multiple stakeholders and opportunities in a fast-moving B2B technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Support & Coordination

  • Prepare and manage draft quotations for Cloudflare licensing, professional services, and support or managed service plans.
  • Work closely with Sales Engineers to translate technical scoping into quote-ready commercial documentation.
  • Coordinate with Cloudflare distributors, including Mindware, on pricing, approvals and quote submissions.
  • Support Account Executives with deal preparation, client coordination and sales follow-up.
  • Schedule and coordinate client demos, onboarding sessions and internal handovers.
  • Support the preparation and distribution of Cloudflare marketing materials and commercial documentation.
  • Track indirect opportunities involving partners and distributors.

Sales & Account Operations

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date opportunity and account information within Zoho CRM.
  • Track renewals and coordinate timely preparation and follow-up.
  • Maintain structured weekly sales reporting covering pipeline activity, renewals and deals in progress.
  • Act as an operational point of contact for client requirements when Account Executives are unavailable.
  • Gather and organise relevant client information ahead of Account Executive or Sales Engineer involvement.
  • Escalate commercial or operational issues to the appropriate sales, technical or partner teams.
  • Ensure quoting and sales activities follow internal processes and approval workflows.

Key Stakeholders

You will work closely with:

  • Account Executives on opportunities, client interactions and deal execution.
  • Sales Engineers on technical scoping and professional services requirements.
  • Cloudflare partners and distributors on pricing, approvals and commercial coordination.
  • Sales leadership and delivery operations on pipeline visibility, handovers and execution.

The role reports to the Sales Director.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Commercial Coordination or a similar role, ideally within a B2B technology, SaaS, cybersecurity or IT environment.
  • Experience preparing and coordinating quotes, renewals and commercial documentation.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining CRM data and sales pipelines.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating across sales, technical, partner and/or client-facing teams.
  • Fluent Arabic, French and English, both written and spoken.
  • Comfortable working with CRM platforms such as Zoho, Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook and Word.
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail.
  • A structured, proactive and ownership-driven approach to work.
  • Ability to work full-time in alignment with Gulf Standard Time.

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

  • Cloudflare, cybersecurity, cloud or network infrastructure solutions.
  • A technology vendor, reseller, system integrator or distributor environment.
  • Working with Cloudflare partners or distributors such as Mindware.
  • Professional Services quoting and support-plan packaging.
  • Supporting Account Executives and Sales Engineers within a B2B technology sales cycle.
  • Managing renewal calendars, partner coordination and indirect sales opportunities.

Working Hours: Alignment with Gulf Standard Time (UAE) required

Benefits

What BRIXIO Offers

  • A fully remote role with exposure across the MENAT region.
  • The opportunity to work within a growing Cloudflare-focused business.
  • Direct collaboration with commercial, technical and delivery teams.
  • Exposure to regional clients, partners and distributors.
  • Career development opportunities across Sales Operations, Partner Enablement and Regional Coordination.
  • A competitive local compensation package.

jobs.title: Professional Services Engineer - Cloudflare Implementation
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, with operations spanning Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

As a Professional Services Engineer, you will design, build and implement Cloudflare environments for BRIXIO's French-speaking enterprise and public-sector clients and help take them successfully into production.

This is a hands-on implementation role covering onboarding, migration from existing CDN and WAF platforms, WAF and DDoS deployment, Zero Trust rollout, DNS cutovers, SASE and production hardening.

You will work within properly planned and governed client projects. The Delivery Manager owns the project plan and delivery governance, while the Principal Architect provides technical authority and owns the overall design.

Your responsibility is the build, validation and client-facing technical implementation.

The client portfolio includes French banks, industrial groups, public bodies and media organisations. You will regularly work directly with their technical teams in French, explaining what you are implementing, why particular decisions have been made and how production changes will be managed.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

Cloudflare Experience

jobs.title: MSP Engineer, Network and Security - Rotating shifts
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Core Services and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, Europe and Asia, with offices in Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

BRIXIO is building a genuine managed services capability — not simply a ticket queue.

As an MSP Engineer, you will operate client Cloudflare environments during your shift, combining reactive incident management with structured, proactive engineering.

You will detect and investigate issues before clients report them, resolve incidents within committed service levels, execute production changes under controlled processes, and carry out proactive activities designed to improve security, performance and service stability over time.

Managed services and support are delivered by the same team. This means your role spans both incident response and scheduled proactive work, with proactive engineering time protected within the rota rather than fitted around ticket volume.

You will be the technical responder on shift, but you will not carry an account alone. Client relationship management and reporting are owned by the Delivery Manager, while technical arbitration sits with the MSP & Support Lead.

There is no expectation to be reachable outside your scheduled shift.

Working Pattern

BRIXIO operates a follow-the-sun model across its teams in Morocco and the Philippines, designed around client demand and defined service coverage windows.

Early Shift

09:00–17:00 Morocco time

Provides full coverage during the core client peak window and is named on relevant client contracts.

Late Shift

15:00–23:00 Morocco time

Extends coverage across the peak window and includes an overlap and structured handover with the Early Shift.

Weekend Rotation

Weekend coverage is shared across the team on a reduced rotation. Sunday forms part of the service window for Gulf clients.

Shifts are managed through a published rota issued in advance, so you will know your schedule ahead of time.

Each shift change includes a 30-minute overlap and written handover, ensuring that engineers do not inherit undocumented situations.

Under the current operating model, Gulf night coverage is provided by colleagues in the Philippines within their normal working day. Shift patterns may evolve as the team and client base grow, with any changes discussed with the team in advance.

Weekend rotation is compensated in accordance with Moroccan law and Equans policy.

What You Will Do

Service Operations

  • Staff the client intake channel during your shift, qualify and triage incoming requests, and own first response within committed service levels.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents across the Cloudflare stack, including WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and caching, DNS, TLS, load balancing, Zero Trust and Workers.
  • Qualify monitoring alerts, act on them using documented runbooks and create tickets where required.
  • Escalate appropriately and early to senior engineers, the MSP & Support Lead and Cloudflare Support in accordance with the escalation matrix.
  • Maintain accurate ticket records in Jira, including detection source, priority and timestamps, supporting accurate service-level reporting.

Change Execution

  • Execute production configuration changes under formal change control, including four-eyes validation and a documented rollback plan before deployment.
  • Provide named technical coverage during declared client go-live windows, including pre-go-live validation and active monitoring following cutover.
  • Maintain Cloudflare configuration as code using Terraform and version control.
  • Investigate and resolve configuration drift identified through automated nightly comparisons.
  • Ensure production changes are properly documented and traceable.

Proactive Engineering

  • Deliver scheduled proactive activities including configuration and security-posture audits, false-positive analysis, cache and rate-limit calibration, DNS and certificate hygiene, and unused-rule cleanup.
  • Analyse traffic and security telemetry using Cloudflare Analytics, GraphQL API and log data to identify potential problems before they affect clients.
  • Recommend and implement security and performance improvements and demonstrate their impact.
  • Contribute to root-cause analysis following major incidents.
  • Identify recurring causes and raise them through the problem-management process so they can be eliminated rather than repeatedly resolved.

Collaboration & Knowledge

  • Work closely with client NOC and security teams, including participation in operational channels and major incident bridges where BRIXIO is integrated with the client's teams.
  • Write and maintain runbooks, Standard Operating Procedures and configuration documentation in Confluence.
  • Support BRIXIO's professional services and implementation teams during escalations and handovers into managed service.
  • Actively share technical knowledge across the team to reduce dependency on individual engineers.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in network, security or cloud operations.
  • Experience within managed services, NOC or SOC environments is a strong advantage.
  • Solid working knowledge of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, caching and CDN mechanics.
  • Practical Cloudflare experience across WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and DNS.
  • Where Cloudflare experience is partial, BRIXIO will fund Cloudflare certification, which you will be expected to complete within the first six months.
  • Confidence using diagnostic tools including curl, dig, traceroute, browser developer tools and HAR analysis.
  • Experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Git/version control.
  • Scripting capability using Python or Bash.
  • Understanding of web application architecture and application-security fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Jira Service Management and ITIL-aligned incident, change and problem-management processes.
  • Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP is an advantage.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

You will handle incidents both in writing and verbally with French- and English-speaking enterprise clients, including during high-pressure situations. You will also prepare client-facing incident and change records in both languages.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Arabic is a significant advantage when supporting BRIXIO's Gulf accounts.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Calm and methodical when working under incident pressure.
  • Disciplined about escalation rather than improvising when the situation requires additional expertise.
  • Serious about documentation and maintaining accurate technical records.
  • Able to explain technical situations clearly to non-technical stakeholders in either French or English.
  • Comfortable acknowledging what they do not know and finding the right answer.
  • Reliable within a rotating shift environment and disciplined about providing clean handovers to colleagues.
  • Comfortable working remotely within a distributed international team spanning Morocco, the Philippines, France and the Gulf.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Increasing numbers of issues are detected and resolved proactively before clients report them.
  • Service-level commitments are consistently met, with any breaches accurately documented and understood.
  • Recurring incidents are progressively eliminated, reducing reactive workload over time.
  • Production changes are executed safely, with rollback plans prepared even when they are not needed.
  • Shift handovers are clean, tickets are accurate and runbooks remain current.
  • Clients develop confidence in the engineers operating their environments.
  • Proactive engineering contributes measurably to improved security, performance and service stability.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Develop genuine Cloudflare depth through access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification.

What we are building at Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

 

#1 What problem are we solving, and why is this an important problem to solve

The current/traditional research methods companies rely on are slow, expensive, and superficial. Running great research also requires expertise, which is a blocker to many companies. That directly affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them.

 

#2 The team you will join

You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives. Our team has the combination of decades of market research knowledge, incredible engineering ability, and experience building companies.

 

#3 How we operate

  • We truly care about our clients and the problem we solve. That means we humbly go the extra mile every time.

  • We work hard, and we have fun.

  • To keep our quality bar incredibly high, we want to execute with the smallest possible team.

 

The Role

As a Sales Director at Conveo, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle — from building pipeline to closing enterprise deals and expanding accounts. You’ll partner directly with the founders to refine our go-to-market strategy while landing and growing some of the world’s biggest brands. This is a high-impact role where you’ll navigate complex orgs, multi-stakeholder deals, and long sales cycles ($45K-$500K+), selling into industries like CPG, Pharma, Tech, and Financial Services.

 

Your Mission

1. Create Demand & Build Pipeline

  • Own a defined ICP and territory plan, executing multi-threaded outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls).

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads with crisp discovery and problem framing.

  • Build and maintain 4–5× pipeline coverage to hit and exceed quota.

2. Win Deals & Expand Accounts

  • Lead consultative discovery and run tailored demos tied to customer workflows and KPIs.

  • Navigate complex buying committees (economic buyer, users, procurement, legal) and manage deal timelines.

  • Negotiate and close clean, scalable contracts; expand initial wins into multi-market, multi-year agreements.

3. Be the Market & Product Expert

  • Translate customer pain points into compelling ROI cases.

  • Stay on top of competitor moves and market trends to sharpen messaging and objection handling.

  • Capture customer success stories and proof points that strengthen Conveo’s market narrative.

4. Partner with Founders & Marketing

  • Provide structured product feedback to shape roadmap priorities.

  • Collaborate on campaigns, content, and sequences to boost funnel conversion.

  • Maintain crisp CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Qualified pipeline coverage (≥4–5× quota), stage velocity, and win-rate improvements.

  • Strong win rates (high stage-to-stage conversion, clean qualification/disqualification, and rising expansion (multi-market/multi-year, increased ACV & ARR ).

  • Referencable customers and repeatable plays we can roll out across the team.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 5–15 years of enterprise sales in SaaS, Martech, or Market Research.

  • Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals (ACV $75K+) with long sales cycles.

  • Experience selling to Fortune 500 companies.

  • Great if you have a strong network or background in market research, insights, or consulting.

  • High energy, self-motivation, and a relentless drive to win.

  • Excellent communication skills — active listener, persuasive storyteller, and trusted advisor.

  • Comfortable with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce) and multi-channel outreach.

  • Team player who thrives in a fast-paced, low-politics, high-standards environment.

 

Why join us

At Conveo, you’ll join a team that genuinely enjoys working and spending time together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That’s why we run quarterly team off-sites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun. Our next one is a retreat in the Alps this March.

 

Plus

  • Own attention for a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company.

  • Direct access to founders and high-leverage operators.

  • Help define how AI-powered research becomes the global default.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

  • Opportunities to travel globally and build real relationships with customers shaping the future.
